df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join the two source tables on 'starttime' column (common column with string type and unique enough for join)
# This join will combine rows with the same starttime from both sources side by side
# Since both sources have the same schema, joining on starttime will produce columns with suffixes
# We need to select columns from either table (preferably from df0) to match target schema exactly

# Perform inner join on 'starttime'

# After join, columns from df0 and df1 are duplicated with suffixes.
# The target schema matches the source schema exactly (no duplicated columns).

]]
